pinned_comment: O que você queria que a IA aprendesse agora? 🧠
notes: Hook changed from 'A IA APRENDEU SOZINHA.' to 'O ALARME DE MEGA APRENDEU SOZINHO.' (6 words): NEURO lists 'IA' as a headline to avoid, and of the three facts only the mega alarm literally learns by itself (the +100 items are 'the AI learned to recognise'; the per-species stats are a statistics feature), so the hook claims only what is true and opens a 'COMO?' curiosity gap paid off at the drop (7.2 s ≈ 36%). Fact order changed accordingly (mega alarm first, then +100 items, then stats). The body on the ground is a generic cartoon silhouette, not Pokémon art. The stats card shows category names only (no numbers). Audio master trimmed with "lufs": -14.6 because the first render's AAC true peak was -0.7 dBFS (see report: shared limiter ceiling). Loop bridge returns to the hook frame.
